summary: Created a single-phase implementation plan to add a `## Building a single file` subsection (plus its required Table of Contents entry) to CONTRIBUTING.md, documenting that bare `lake env lean <file>` is unsafe on module-system files here and that `lake build <Module.Name>` is the correct single-module build.
